run_create_video_color: run the script to generate a color transfer video from a trained experiment pickle file
run_push_image: run the push_image function to apply a transport map to an image with gamma interpolation
run_plot: run the plot function to save a side-by-side image comparison with color transfer results
review_plot: review the plot function that concatenates source, target, and pushed images and saves them
review_push_image: review the push_image function that batches pixel transport using a JIT-compiled push gradient
